text:
marta: Heads-up — legal asked for an updated policy on request/response logs. They want to be sure we never persist raw PII for hosted API calls, but they also want enough telemetry to debug regressions. Can we land on a concrete sampling + redaction proposal?

aj: Short answer: separate concerns — sampling for volume + redaction for safety. Start with deterministic 1% full-request sampling per tenant + 0.1% cross-tenant. Everything else gets redacted before long-term storage.

marta: TLDR: deterministic sampling how?

aj: Hash the tenant_id + request_id with a stable salt and choose N out of 10k. That way we can reproduce samples across services without correlation risk. e.g.:
```json
{"sampling": {"type": "deterministic", "rate_per_tenant": 0.01, "global_min_rate": 0.001, "salt_version": "v3"}}
```

taylor: Concern: onboarding teams will want request bodies for debugging model regressions. If we redact aggressively we lose signal. Can we keep a cached, short-lived store (7 days) with stricter access controls instead of long-term retention of any raw payloads?

vikas: Yes. Proposal: two retention tiers. Ephemeral raw store (7 days, encrypted, audit+approval access only). Long-term telemetry has only metadata + redacted text + similarity hashes. Also add a redaction pipeline: regex -> entity extractor -> ML-PII classifier.

marta: Example redaction flow?

elaine: From ops/console POV we should show a preview UI that highlights redacted spans and why (regex vs ML). That helps SREs request unredacted view via an approval workflow (not self-service). Also show the sampling provenance.

aj: Also want to avoid everyone enabling verbose request logging by flipping a flag. Add an API header: `X-Privacy-Level: none|partial|full`. Default for hosted = partial. Private/dedicated tenants can opt into full if they sign a DPA and enable ephemeral store.

vikas: For redaction specifics: default patterns: credit_card, ssn, email, phone, jwt, bearer tokens. After regex stage, run an NER model tuned for PII and then a final redact-by-category pass. Store replaced text like `[REDACTED_EMAIL]` (category names, no original).

marta: Who's owning the config + rollout? We need a feature flag + rollout plan so we can A/B the sampling rates without churn.

aj: I'll own the sampling config and deterministic salt rotation. Vikas can own the redaction pipeline. We should store configs in central infra config (gitops + feature-flag) and expose per-tenant overrides.

elaine: UX: console should expose per-tenant sampling and a toggle for ephemeral raw-logs request with a 2-step approval. Add audit trail and who viewed raw payloads.

marta: Ops-bot will you add an incidentless alert if redact pipeline drops below 99.9% throughput for 1m? We can't have unredacted payload leak.

ops-bot: alert created -> infra/alerts#PII_REDACT_PIPELINE_LATENCY (threshold: 0.1% failed redactions per minute); runbook linked. :white_check_mark:

aj: One more detail — sampling should be applied before any enrichment that could reintroduce PII (e.g., geocoding IPs). Enrichment for sampled raw store only. Non-sampled flows get minimal enrichment (country only, no ip).

vikas: Also need to version redaction rules (v1 regex list, v2 ner model). Keep changelog and ability to re-run redaction on historical ephemeral dumps for audits.

marta: Ok next steps: aj create PR with deterministic-sampler code + config schema; vikas add redaction pipeline prototype + tests; elaine mockup console approval UX. I'll sync with legal on retention windows. Aim to ship canary in two weeks.

aj: Will do. Opening a RFC/PR today.

elaine: I'll sketch the UX in figma and post link here when ready. :eyes: 

marta: Thanks all — ping me if you need legal contact. End of thread.
